subject.title: Gateway memory leak: 389MB → 14.7GB over 4 days with session accumulation

question: What representative Gateway RSS/heap soak or profiling evidence is sufficient to close this broad memory tracker after the current narrow mitigations?
rationale: Current main contains real mitigations and open partial fixes, but maintainer discussion and newer field data still require human judgment about the workload, profiling artifacts, and closure threshold.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until representative profiling shows plateauing and remaining focused fixes land or split cleanly.

options.title: Split focused subissues
options.body: Move known contributors such as session-store bloat, diagnostic hot paths, and cache retention into narrower canonical issues while preserving this issue's field data as umbrella context.

options.title: Close after one mitigation
options.body: Close after a selected narrow fix lands, accepting the risk that recent multi-agent field reports remain unproven against current main.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until representative profiling shows plateauing and remaining focused fixes land or split cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to osolmaz and their comment defines the current profiling and representative-soak closure bar.
